scenes.tts: You need small paper cups you cannot see through, cotton balls, foil, and rubber bands. For smells, use kitchen foods like orange peel and a cinnamon stick. Add two juices that look alike.
scenes.narration: You need small paper cups you cannot see through, cotton balls, foil, and rubber bands. For smells, use kitchen foods like orange peel and a cinnamon stick. Add two juices that look alike.

scenes.tts: Put a cotton ball in each cup, and add one smell to two cups, so every smell has a pair. An adult covers each cup with foil and pokes the holes. Label the cups.
scenes.narration: Put a cotton ball in each cup, and add one smell to two cups, so every smell has a pair. An adult covers each cup with foil and pokes the holes. Label the cups.

scenes.tts: Your child sniffs and matches the pairs. Later, they pinch their nose, sip juice, then let go. Most children notice the flavour arrive when the nose opens.
scenes.narration: Your child sniffs and matches the pairs. Later, they pinch their nose, sip juice, then let go. Most children notice the flavour arrive when the nose opens.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child. Use kitchen foods only. Check every food for allergies before tasting.
scenes.narration: Stay with your child. Use kitchen foods only. Check every food for allergies before tasting.

scenes.line: The full guide, with safety notes, is on this page.
